coding_context.description: The replication tested whether using spatial metaphors to describe time affects reasoning about temporal sequences. For example, participants exposed to spatial frames of reference (e.g., “ahead,” “behind”) processed temporal questions differently, supporting the idea that spatial cognition structures temporal reasoning.

coding_context.reported_success_quote: the replications were nonetheless consistent with the key feature of the original demonstration: object-priming increased the likelihood of selecting Monday compared to Friday.
